test_title: SSC GD Constable Previous Year Paper (Held on: 8th December 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: I walk at a speed of 10 km/h and cover a distance in 2 hours. If I increase my speed by 5 km/h, how early would I reach my destination?
solution:
**Given:**

Walking speed = 10 km/h 

Covered distance = 2 hours 

If walking speed increased by 5 km/h.

**Formula:**

Distance = Speed × Time 

**Calculation:**

Total distance = 10 × 2 = 20 km

Now,

Speed after increased by 5 = 10 + 5 = 15 km/h

So, new time to cover the same distance 

⇒ (20\15) × 60 = 80 minutes

So, time will be deducted = 120 - 80 = 40 minutes.

**∴ I would reach my destination 40 minutes early.**
